doc: Area-weighted mean: row means (float32 pairwise accumulation for a float32 image) weighted by cos(lat) in float64. A float64 accumulation of the same image differs by 2.3e-8 relative, so a port is within the float32 default. The 256x128 Earth reference. Input convention: the u8 input(s) img are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

u8_inputs.img: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
